data.title: Damac District
data.about:
DAMAC District is a dynamic mixed-use development located in the heart of DAMAC Hills. Developed by DAMAC Properties, the project brings together residential and commercial excellence across three striking towers. Two towers are residential and one is commercial, housing a total of 1,008 units. Offering stylish 1 and 2 bedroom apartments along with premium office spaces, DAMAC District is designed to blend modern living with professional opportunities.

This development combines elegant design, curated amenities, and an ideal location. With facilities such as a swimming pool, fitness centre, clubhouse, and landscaped gardens, the community creates an environment where leisure, wellness, and productivity meet seamlessly. DAMAC District residences are tailored for those who value connectivity, lifestyle, and investment potential.

characteristics_module.title: DAMAC District by DAMAC Properties – Where Lifestyle and Business Connect
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Location Advantage – Situated in DAMAC Hills with access to Hessa Street and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road for seamless citywide connectivity.
  • Premium Amenities – Lifestyle amenities at DAMAC District include swimming pool, clubhouse, fitness centre, and landscaped gardens.
  • Attractive Pricing – Starting from AED 1.1M with a flexible 60/40 payment plan for investors and end-users alike.
  • Developer Excellence – Backed by DAMAC Properties, a leading developer known for landmark projects and strong delivery track record.
  • Diverse Property Mix – You will find 1 and 2-bedroom apartments as well as contemporary offices in DAMAC District.
  • High ROI Potential – Strategically located and designed to appeal to both residents and businesses, ensuring strong rental yields.
  • Lifestyle Balance – A mixed-use destination where you can live, work, and relax in one integrated address.
  • Community Integration – Part of the vibrant DAMAC Hills master community with retail, golf, and leisure attractions nearby.

location_tile.title: Connected Living in DAMAC Hills
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
DAMAC District Dubai enjoys a strategic location within DAMAC Hills, offering direct links to Hessa Street (D61) and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road (E311). The community provides effortless access to key business districts, lifestyle destinations, and leisure attractions, making it ideal for both residents and professionals.

  • 3 Minutes – DAMAC Mall
  • 9 Minutes – Trump International Golf Club
  • 10 Minutes – DAMAC Lagoons
  • 10 Minutes – Dubai Sports City
  • 15 Minutes – Al Barsha
  • 25 Minutes – Dubai Marina
  • 25 Minutes – Business Bay
